project_name: InspectAI - Buying House QC & Inspection Intelligence
context: Internal B2B tool for buying house / sourcing QC inspection teams. Automatically turns product & packaging photos into multi-sheet Excel (.xlsx) inspection reports.

theme_strategy.aesthetic_style: Tactical Quality Control & Technical Precision (Industrial Obsidian + Amber Unresolved Highlights + Emerald Pass Indicators)

headings.rule: Never use Inter for headings. Keep hierarchy gaps within 2 Tailwind size steps.

monospace.font_family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
monospace.usage: Used for Barcodes, SKUs, Measurements, AI Confidence Scores, Data Tables, and Unresolved Badges

colors.tinted_neutrals: Always use cool slate-tinted dark surfaces, never flat #000000

layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Dashboard & Inspection Deck Grid
layout_and_spacing.border_padding: Containers with borders MUST have minimum internal padding p-5 to prevent text edge collision

sections.name: Team Header & Navigation
sections.key_elements: Brand logo, Active Inspection Batch selector, Inspector Team profile badge, Light/Dark toggle, Quick History trigger
sections.rule: Header must have glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80) and z-50 stack depth.

sections.name: Batch Photo Upload Dropzone
sections.key_elements: Multi-photo drag-and-drop zone, live file thumbnail carousel/stack, count meter, 'Generate Report' high-contrast action CTA
sections.rule: Supports dragging 10-50+ photos at once. Shows instant preview thumbnail gallery.

sections.name: Live AI Processing Pipeline
sections.key_elements: Multi-stage progress bar: 1. Uploading -> 2. AI Visual Grouping -> 3. OCR Label & Barcode Scan -> 4. Defect Detection -> 5. Excel Template Compilation -> 6. Done
sections.rule: Shows live percentage progress, current photo being processed, and real-time step status icons.

sections.name: Product Analysis & Excel Workbook Workbench
sections.key_elements: Tabbed per-product view (Sheet 1: Product A, Sheet 2: Product B...), Extracted Label Text, SKU, Barcode, Unit Counts, Defect Summaries, 'Not Visible / Unresolved' deliberate badges, and Excel Live Table Preview
sections.rule: Unresolved/unproven fields must be visually distinguished with Amber 'Not Visible in Photos' pill badges, maintaining strictly truthful QC standards.

sections.name: Traceable Original Photo Gallery
sections.key_elements: Thumbnail drawer per product, full-screen lightbox modal with visual defect bounding overlays, zoom pan controls, photo timestamp & upload hash
sections.rule: Preserves original photos linked directly to each generated Excel sheet row.

sections.name: Inspection History & Excel Download Center
sections.key_elements: Historical reports table, total units inspected, defect ratio, one-click .xlsx download button, search & date filter
sections.rule: Single click finishes and downloads ready-to-use formatted multi-sheet .xlsx file.

component_rules.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: Every button, link, input, tab, card, modal, and key data metric MUST include data-testid (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid="generate-report-button", data-testid="product-tab-product-1", data-testid="download-excel-button", data-testid="photo-upload-dropzone"
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner component from src/components/ui/sonner.jsx for upload feedback and export completion notifications
component_rules.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn Tabs, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Progress, Badge, ScrollArea, Table, Alert, Accordion with customized dark slate borders and glowing status highlights
component_rules.no_transparent_headers: Header and overlays must have solid/semi-solid background with backdrop blur so content beneath never bleeds unreadably

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, functional React application in frontend code with Javascript (.js/.jsx files).
Implement Team Login flow with mock login credentials option for easy review.
Implement drag-and-drop batch upload accepting multiple product/packaging images simultaneously.
Implement simulated real-time AI processing progress bar showing photo grouping, OCR scanning, defect identification, and Excel generation.
Structure the inspection report into distinct sheets/tabs per identified product design.
Clearly highlight unresolved/unproven fields with 'Not Visible in Photos' amber warnings as requested in the specification.
Provide live Excel-styled table preview and functional .xlsx file export (using SheetJS / xlsx package or Blob download) containing separate worksheets for each product.
Ensure all key UI elements have clear data-testid attributes for automated testing.
